description: This file defines tuning configurations for ARM Cortex-A17 processors within a build system, specifying features, architectures, and flags for different processor variants (including NEON, VFPv4, and HF variants). It sets features, architecture options, and package architecture overrides based on processor features.

methods.name: bb.utils.contains
methods.description: A utility method used to check if a variable contains a specific feature or string, used here to conditionally append flags and configurations.
